sources.entry: Agent Guard by JeongJaeSoon - Real-time secret-leak guardrails for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex), Git hooks, and CI.

summary.one_liner: A local-first guardrail that blocks AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) from reading risky .env files, masks secret-like output, and scans changes with gitleaks before they reach Git.
summary.what_it_does: Agent Guard blocks common secret-exposure paths before a supported agent tool runs, such as reading .env files, and redacts secret-like values in supported tool output. Before an agent's git commit or git push runs, it scans the staged added lines with gitleaks and blocks the command on a finding, and it refuses --no-verify and --no-gpg-sign for agents. A native pre-commit hook scans staged changes for any local commit, and a GitHub Action scans checked-out files on push or pull request as a backstop. It also provides direct CLI commands (scan-working-tree, scan-staged, scan-path) and a metadata-only support log export. The README says it has no hosted account or telemetry and processes data locally and ephemerally, though an optional endpoint-backed PII provider is mentioned.
use_cases: stop an AI coding agent from reading .env secrets
block secrets from being committed to Git
scan staged changes for API keys and tokens before commit
mask secrets in Claude Code or Codex tool output
add a gitleaks pre-commit hook to a repository
run a secret scan in GitHub Actions on push or pull request
notable: Covers agent git commit and git push paths, including the staged-file, tracked-change, and alias-expansion cases the README describes
Refuses --no-verify and --no-gpg-sign on agent commit and push commands
Native pre-commit hook, Claude Code and Codex plugins, and GitHub Action share one gitleaks-based scanning model
Infrastructure failure mode can be set to closed so scan failures block the command
Metadata-only support log export with mode-0600 file creation
caveats: Windows is not currently supported; macOS and Linux on x64 and arm64 only
Defense-in-depth only; the README says it is not a vault, DLP system, EDR, or credential rotator
In Claude Code and Codex plugins, the default infrastructure failure mode warns and lets the command continue when a scan cannot run
keywords: keep api keys out of git
